assets.title: strict pass rate
assets.description: Dex Horthy's chart compares strict pass rates on his 17-checkpoint subset: Opus 5 at 23.5 percent and Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 at 5.9 percent, with the original paper's Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 rates shown below for context.
assets.alt_text: Horizontal bars compare strict checkpoint pass rates. Opus 5 passes four of seventeen checkpoints, while Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 each pass one.

assets.heading: the shape of a better oracle for software quality
assets.title: the experiment I want to run next
assets.description: Dex Horthy proposes scoring a frontier model's first seven checkpoints by whether a smaller model can successfully implement checkpoint eight on the inherited codebase.
assets.alt_text: Three rows show Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Opus 5 building checkpoints one through seven, followed by Sonnet 5 attempting checkpoint eight.
